verdicts.reason: A sets the headline, window and venue details on one shared left edge, so it reads as one deliberate column. But the headline is small next to the huge window, the details are tiny and sit cramped right under the window, and the right-aligned date line breaks the left edge that the address line sets. B scatters the three parts onto three different axes: the headline is jammed into the top-left corner, the window is centred and the details sit in the bottom-right. That leaves no shared edge and uneven margins, and the headline and details are also undersized, so it looks arbitrary rather than designed.
